errors.says: The Neumann evaluation (k=ceil(p/(alpha^2 theta))<=alpha^2+1 iterations) keeps every iterate in the disk grid, and its tape movement over windows of radius about sqrt(p) alpha costs O(tp sqrt(p) alpha).
errors.paper: The window of radius ceil(sqrt p) alpha belongs to the S' procedure (3742-3744). The Neumann evaluation's E-tilde calls use windows of radius m=ceil(sqrt p/(2 alpha)), each costing O(tp(1+sqrt p/alpha)), and it is the k-1<=alpha^2 calls that total O(tp sqrt p alpha) (3769-3783).

errors.says: Every nonzero residual of an edge contains a norm-one vector, namely a coordinate unit outside the supports involved, hence has an orthonormal basis.
errors.paper: The norm-one vector in a residual is a tensor product of chosen norm-one vectors, which for the lines P and Q (and residuals such as P tensor <t_Y>) are the tensor indicator vectors, not coordinate units; and passing from nonalternating to an orthonormal basis needs the separate plane-absorption argument with w+a, w+b, w+a+b (1073-1102), which the step skips.

chain: The tree reaches the O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) bound by the paper's route: radix digits and the CRT map, Gaussian resampling with retained permutations, the Bluestein chirp and twist into ring convolution, synthetic transforms whose rounds are simultaneous layers, the two network-driven procedures, the parameter choice, exact recovery and the cost table. Every core link is derived with the paper's quantities. It thins only at the edges: the stream primitives the movement costs rest on are used but never stated, the S1 reduction is a single quoted step (filled in later by S5.9-S5.10 and S9.12-S9.14), and the conjecture-refutation clause is only asserted in S0.

steps.note: h=100, triple-indexed banks X_a,Y_a, N=v^3, m=h^3, and the three-stage network giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire are all stated, with the wire count W.

A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and intermediate frames can be chosen so that each edge only changes frame cheaply.
Nondegenerate subspace labels in F^{tensor 3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and the central 3->4 edges as the only decreasing ones, each losing h.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate U in V, with the N negative source projections as the exceptions, each first edge 2P_{U_a} of rank one.
Sum of absolute dimension changes Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, then s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b after adding the N source ranks.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 give s<Wm.

M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m for X_a, zero to identity otherwise), so the bit network applies Phi_{I_m}, the shear H<-H+D, on every row including scratch rows.
A rank-a edge matrix factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and its shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V); summing edge ranks gives exactly s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W give F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1); with s/W<m^tau, tau=1-2^{-50} (eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20), the geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: P06 rebuilds the whole central saving with its defining quantities. It covers the fixed h=100 bank-exchange network, frames commuting with pointwise gates, the nested labels with the central 3->4 loss of h, rank equal to dimension change with the N rank-one source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b, the ratios 100/539 and 101/539, the endpoint identity I_m, edges as exactly rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. All nine steps are reconstructed in the roles they play in the chain.
